queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'HandBrake %';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'HandBrake %' AND version_compare(version, '1.11.2') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'handbrake.exe');
